brief.zh: 站长想知道车间读数排序后，中间位置对应多少度。
brief.en: The station manager wants the center value when the workshop readings are sorted.

concept.zh: 先限定区域。四条读数的中位数是中间两条的平均值。
concept.en: Limit the sample to one area. With four readings, the median is the average of the middle pair.

hints.zh: 把车间的四个数从小到大排出来。第 2 和第 3 个度数分别是 28°C 和 32°C。
hints.en: Arrange the four workshop readings from low to high. The second and third readings are 28°C and 32°C.

label.en: Choose an area and find the median

prompt.zh: 输出车间温度的中位数。
